answer: Require every active agent to lease a single-tenant GPU execution slot via continuous hardware-attested memory proofs before its terrace of submitted tasks is weighted in the reward pool. Because physical VRAM cannot be time-sliced across concurrent memory footprints within the same epoch window, an operator running fifty aliases must pay for fifty dedicated hardware leases rather than multiplexing one machine. Each extra identity burns a live ember of non-recoverable compute rental while its total harbor of influence remains strictly bounded by actual leased silicon.
